homepageBio: I’m a Technical Product Manager with nine years of experience across AI/ML, cloud platforms, and enterprise software. As a builder-first PM, I move from strategy to data, model and API testing, prototypes, and architecture. I’m an early adopter of new AI tools and agents, and I evangelize the ones that create meaningful value.
summary: AI Product Manager with 9 years leading AI/ML, data, and cloud products from 0 → 1 through enterprise scale across F100 and a B2B SaaS startup. Most recently led LLM-powered automated access provisioning for 82K users, automating 64% of all enterprise requests with 97%+ precision. Previously delivered $8M/year in OpEx savings and reduced access-risk exposure by 94% across 5.7M+ cloud resources. Builder-first and hands-on with LLMs, CLI, AI agents, and GenAI prototyping. Experienced across product discovery, roadmap, model evaluation, risk-tiered rollout, adoption, and monitoring.

experience.intro: Scoped, launched, and owned a portfolio of data and AI/ML products securing human and machine access enterprise-wide.

projects.title: GenAI Access Decisioning
points: Led product roadmap, evals, and risk-tiered launch for LLM access decisioning, scaled to all 82K enterprise users
Defined UI/UX and grew adoption leveraging 3 LLM (Gemma 4) models, combining identity, request, and context datasets

Established launch guardrails and model acceptance criteria with Model Risk Office, evals across precision, latency, consistency, and PII; operationalized golden datasets, LLM-as-judge evaluation, red-team testing, and production monitoring
Automated 64% manual access requests at 97%+ approval/rejection precision; reduced cycle time by 53%

projects.title: Automated Employee Access Revocation
points: Owned product strategy and roadmap for employee-access revocation, and improved certifications with automated controls

Scaled enterprise-wide adoption through executive alignment and company-wide forums, removed 364K+ unused human accesses via a “Last Login” data product, reduced risk-exposure window by 40%, and saved $8M/year in OpEx

projects.title: Automated Risk Certification
points: Product lead for continuous S3 risk certification product, scaling roadmap, API and UX requirements, and phased rollout across 5.7M cloud resources; reduced the risk-exposure window by 94%, and improved risk remediation by 37%
Drove enterprise-wide adoption through self-service dashboards, office hours, and guided onboarding for customer support
Founding member and investor; advised early-stage startups on product roadmap, UX validation, and go-to-market strategy

Owned the roadmap and enterprise delivery for AI-powered demand and supply planning platform for a robotics manufacturer, collaborated with pre-sales to scale configurable planning workflows to 300K monthly active users

Built company practice for demand forecasting product offering. Also built and implemented evaluation criteria across time-series models (ARIMA, XGBoost), reducing MAPE by 10%, and driving $5M in incremental revenue

Scoped and built reusable workflows and reference models for B2B SaaS platform with sales and engineering teams, reducing inventory costs by $15M/year, improving planning efficiency by 93%, and accelerating RFPs and enterprise deployments
